🆔 US HR 10643 — H-1B Visa Penalties Jump to $100K and 5 Years

This bill raises the potential penalties for serious violations of the H-1B visa program.

Specifically, it increases the maximum fine for certain violations from $5,000 to $100,000 and the maximum prison sentence from at least 2 years to at least 5 years.

Additionally, the bill increases the fines for document fraud, raising the minimum penalty from $250 to $1,000 and the maximum from $2,000 to $10,000.

The penalties for document fraud also increase to a minimum of $20,000 and a maximum of $50,000, with potential prison sentences extended from at least 3 years to at least 10 years.

Oct. 1, 2026: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/10643
